change_summary: The journal issued an expression of concern saying the editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article. The matter is being looked into and readers will be updated later, and the notice does not say which data or figures are concerned. So the findings are in doubt but not shown to be unreliable.
evaluation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice, supporting a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and says your proposal builds on this finding. The stored paper reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test. The notice says the editors have been made aware of concerns about some of the reported data, but it does not say which data or figures. So it is unclear whether the notice touches the result your Discussion relies on. Overall the impact on your draft is medium, and this is uncertain because the affected data are not named.
recommendation: Your Discussion cites Lopez and Chen [8] as showing reduced activity in recipient mice and says your proposal builds on this finding. The notice says the editors have been made aware of concerns regarding some of the data reported in the article, but it does not say which data or figures are concerned. Hedge the wording of that Discussion sentence, cite the expression of concern, and avoid building new work on this finding for now. The matter is being looked into and readers will be updated when more information is available. Tracking continues, so a retraction would raise a new alert.
